reports.headline: Barça 5–2 Rayo: Yamal hits 50 and then 51
reports.summary: Barcelona came from behind to make it three league wins from three. Raphinha and Lamine Yamal scored twice each, with Yamal's first strike marking his 50th first-team goal for Barça.

reports.headline: Barça 2–0 Athletic: Yamal keeps the right side electric
reports.summary: Raphinha and Fermín scored as Barcelona won 2–0 at Spotify Camp Nou. Lamine Yamal repeatedly tested Unai Simón, hit the underside of the bar and created danger from the right.

reports.headline: Elche 0–5 Barça: a five-goal statement
reports.summary: Raphinha and Fermín scored twice each and Karim Adeyemi added another in a 5–0 win at Martínez Valero. Barça's official report highlighted Lamine Yamal's speed and his involvement in the move preceding Adeyemi's goal.
